headline: Key dependencies in App.tsx require careful editing
what_breaks: packages/excalidraw/types.ts — relies on types defined here
packages/excalidraw/data/library.ts — uses components and states managed in App.tsx
packages/excalidraw/components/ContextMenu.tsx — interacts with app state and context
why: This file is central to the application, managing the main app state and UI interactions. Changes here can ripple through numerous components and affect overall functionality.
checklist: Review changes to state management functions like getObservedAppState.
Check interactions with imported components like ContextMenu and Dialog.
Ensure any new utility functions do not conflict with existing ones from @excalidraw/common.
Validate that changes do not break the expected app behavior in dependent components.
